_what: Outputs of rcdata/sec_sections.py's ours-2 rule, captured 12 Nov 2026 over the inputs of rcdata/tests/sec_sections_cases.py. This is a BASELINE, not an independent truth: it records what ours-2 answers today so that a later edit which moves the text of a shared case cannot pass unnoticed. It says nothing about whether the slice is the right section -- that is #763's hand-checked set. The named-defect tests in test_sec_sections_ours_2.py are the ones that assert ours-2 is BETTER than ours-1; this file only asserts it has not drifted. Two AIF rows were recaptured on 12 Nov 2026 for #756, which gave ours-2 its own 40-F business rule: aif_description_of_business (None -> 26,999, one of the 28 titles ours-1 does not know) and aif_over_the_cap (200,000 -> 239,999, the AIF cap removed). Nothing had stored ours-2 text.
_how_to_recapture: Run sec_sections.cut_item / cut_aif_business under version=OURS_2 over CASES and rewrite this file. Recapture only to ADD a case, or together with a deliberate, reviewed change to ours-2 while nothing has stored ours-2 text yet. Once a board reads ours-2, a changed expectation here is a new rules_version, not an edit of this file.
